NUPHY-RELEASE-NOTES 1 version:1.2.14 [zh-CN] NuPhy Lab 1.2.14
• 新增一石二鸟打字灯效：每次按键从对应位置向横纵扩散，连续输入独立叠加，支持调整颜色与速度。 • 作品库可在当前页面直接播放；打开编辑进入相应创作模式，并保留草稿保护。 • 修正空闲唤醒重置总时长的问题；兼容的 Air75 V3 在 Lab 控灯期间临时托管设备休眠，停止控灯后恢复。 • 补全英文界面，保留用户自定义作品与任务名称的原文。 • 设置新增更新入口与当前键盘适用固件的提示红点，固件入口直达 NuPhyIO 设置页。 • 软件更新窗口随应用语言显示对应版本说明，支持更新、稍后和跳过；同版稍后提醒至少间隔 24 小时。 [en] NuPhy Lab 1.2.14
• Add One stone, two birds: each keystroke sends a cross from its key, with overlapping waves, adjustable colour and speed. • Play artworks directly from the Library. Open edit enters the matching Studio mode and protects unsaved drafts. • Keep the original lighting duration deadline after idle activity. On supported Air75 V3 keyboards, temporarily manage device sleep during Lab lighting and restore it afterwards. • Complete the English interface while preserving user-entered artwork and task names. • Add Settings update controls and a dot for firmware updates verified for the connected keyboard. Open firmware settings directly in NuPhyIO. • Show version-specific release notes and update controls in the application language. Later pauses automatic reminders for the same version for at least 24 hours.
